answer: Most convincing sybil resistance: attestation weight only counts peers outside your kinship cluster, so self-attesting rings earn zero. Trust edges are discounted between agents sharing funds flow or lineage; a knoll of fake accounts stays a frozen glacier of worthless weight. Reputation must come from genuinely independent peers, so an attacker must seed real economic activity for every identity, and the zenith cost scales linearly with cluster size, making bulk identity farming unprofitable.
